<?php
class A { public function f(): void {} }
function go() {
    try {
        echo "BEFORE\n";
        eval('class B extends A { public function f() {} } echo "BODY\n";');
        echo "AFTER\n";
    } catch (CompileError $e) { echo "CATCH-COMPILE\n";
    } catch (Error $e) { echo "CATCH-ERROR\n";
    } catch (Throwable $e) { echo "CATCH-THROWABLE\n";
    } finally { echo "FINALLY\n"; }
    echo "FUNCTION-END\n";
}
go();
echo "END\n";
